Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body: The rules say I can only play 1 Trifle, not 1 Trifle Master Card. Does this rule mean I can not play 2 Orun or 2 Aye? Is it I can play only 1 Trifle master card and then use the other master action to play a non-trifle master card? Or can I play 1 Trifle Master Card, then play another Trifle Master Card but not receive the 2nd Trifle affect?

Messages.Author: mirddes
Messages.Body:
first trifle gives additional MPA, 2nd is legally played and is a normal master

UDHR18/19/27

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Technically, the rules say you can only gain 1 Master Phase Action from Trifles each turn. Your scenario is legal.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> rulebook wrote:
> 1.6.2. Master Cards
> 5. Trifle: Some master cards are identified as trifles. When a Methuselah plays a trifle (and it isn't canceled), she gains an additional master phase action. For an out-of-turn trifle, she gains a master phase action in her next master phase. A Methuselah can gain only one master phase action from trifles in a given master phase; others act like regular master cards.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct answers from mirddes, Jeff Kuta and Ankha: The first uncanceled trifle (for example, Orun) card gives you an additional master phase action. You can use that extra Master Phase Action to play another Orun.

Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body: If I had a card in play that let me have 2 MPA, could I technically play 3 Orun?

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Yes you can.

If you can play a master, you can play a trifle master. It's just that you can't gain more than one master phase action per turn via Trifle masters.
